name: Premium Residency -- Investor and Entrepreneur products (Al-Iqama Al-Mumayaza)

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a verified investment of at least SAR 7 million (approx. USD 1.87 million) in an eligible Saudi business or asset class, plus MISA endorsement of the investment.
requirements.fix_path: Structure a qualifying investment of at least SAR 7 million and obtain MISA endorsement.

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a viable business plan and investment of at least SAR 400,000 (approx. USD 107,000) in a qualifying Saudi venture, backed by an accredited investment entity from the Premium Residency Center's approved list.
requirements.fix_path: Prepare a business plan and secure backing from an accredited investment entity for at least SAR 400,000.

requirements.blocker_text: A higher-tier entrepreneurial track requiring investment of at least SAR 15 million (approx. USD 4 million) in advanced or priority-sector ventures, carrying broader benefits than the standard Entrepreneur track.
requirements.fix_path: Structure a qualifying advanced-venture investment of at least SAR 15 million.

evidence_required.document: Commercial registration, share certificates, or investment agreements proving the qualifying amount
MISA endorsement (Investor track) or accredited investment-entity backing (Entrepreneur tracks)
Medical examination and criminal-background check from country of origin

outcome.physical_presence_requirement: no minimum physical presence requirement to maintain the residency

sources.title: Premium Residency Center (pr.gov.sa) -- official Saudi government portal, Investor and Entrepreneur Residency products. Mirabello Consultancy -- Saudi Premium Residency 2026 guide, cross-checked fee figures for all 7 product tracks (SAR 7M Investor, SAR 400K Entrepreneur Standard, SAR 15M Entrepreneur Premium)
Global Law Experts -- Premium Residency Saudi Arabia guide, independent cross-check of the 5 category-based product tracks and family-inclusion rules

notes: SOURCING METHOD NOTE, flagged honestly: pr.gov.sa is the genuine official .gov.sa government domain for this programme (registered with the Digital Government Authority, confirmed via my.gov.sa's official agency listing), but it disallows automated fetching via robots.txt, so this route's specific SAR figures rest on convergent cross-corroboration across multiple independent tier-3 relocation-consultancy and law-firm sources rather than a directly fetched primary page -- every one of the 6+ independent secondary sources checked in this research pass agrees on the same figures (SAR 7M Investor, SAR 400K Entrepreneur Standard, SAR 15M Entrepreneur Premium), which is a meaningfully different confidence level than a single-source claim, but still short of this project's normal direct-fetch standard. Flagged as a genuine limitation for a follow-up session to resolve, e.g. via a cached/archived copy of pr.gov.sa's product pages. STRUCTURAL FINDING: none of Premium Residency's 7 product tracks lead to citizenship or count toward naturalisation's residence clock in any accelerated way confirmed in this research pass -- Saudi Arabia is explicit and consistent across every source checked that Premium Residency is a residency-only status, structurally sealed off from the citizenship track, a sharper wall than seen in any other country in this dataset (even the UAE's Golden Visa doesn't carry this explicit a citizenship firewall). All three product tracks in this file (Investor, Entrepreneur Standard, Entrepreneur Premium) carry identical Outcome rights (work, study, family, 5-year renewable duration) per every source checked -- correctly modeled as three plain OR-logic requirement_groups with no outcome_override, since an override should represent a genuine difference in what the route grants, not just a different qualifying investment size. This is a deliberate contrast with pl_business_activity's OR-groups (also no override, same reasoning) versus cases like the Entrepreneur Premium track initially being drafted with a duplicate override that added no real distinction -- caught and removed during this build rather than left in as false structural signal.
